description:
Build an illustrative solar-power facility 3D demo using the same lead modeling agent as the hallway and house demos. Preserve existing work; use a separate demo folder with shared reusable tools. Read AGENTS.md and the model-evidence skill; inspect the current Three.js workflow before choosing modeling/export tools.

Sources: Amrize Portland Plant Solar and Storage plans https://fremontcountyco.gov/sites/default/files/planning-and-zoning/current-projects/Site_Plans_3.pdf ; county project page https://fremontcountyco.gov/content/sru-25-003-amrize-cement-inc-portland-plant-solar-storage-project-hwy-120florence . The 17-page PDF documents 33.35 MW solar and 42 MWh battery storage near Florence, Colorado. Useful pages: 5/C101 site and battery area; 8/C104 array layout and terrain contours; 10/C200 panel sections/dimensions; 12/C202 battery elevations.

Start with terrain and panel layout, then access roads, inverter skids, battery containers, fencing and the documented substation footprint. Compare rendered views and dimensions against drawings; separate documented geometry from assumptions. Deliver reproducible source, preview views and a Blender-compatible export if feasible. Keep this useful for an industrial/worksite demo, not just a small-object showcase.

Plans dated September 15, 2025 are marked NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION. Construction status is unverified; do not call this under construction or as-built. Approximate equipment dimensions and by-others details are not verified engineering. Public availability does not establish an open license; retain attribution and check reuse constraints before public publication. No third-party contact without authorization. Keep private original hallway media and location metadata out of this public repository. Claim and maintain this ticket in the existing Beadwork store, recording tests, artifacts and blockers. Same existing hallway modeling agent is responsible; current computer assignment is unconfirmed and should be recorded on pickup. WOOT posted this handoff at the user's request.

comments.text: Pickup on the Windows gaming laptop by the same lead modeling agent. User now authorized starting solar while reviewing the house/capture markers later. Implementation target is a separate solar-facility route in the existing owner-private Sites source, with reusable Three.js tools; existing hallway, exterior and house preserved. Will inspect the 17-page county plans, retain attribution/status and distinguish plan geometry from illustrative details. Acceptance includes terrain/array layout, roads, inverter skids, battery containers, fencing, documented substation footprint, source-comparison views, reproducible source and GLB export if feasible, checks, private deployment and live verification.

Implemented a separate private solar-facility route. C100 vector extraction retains 1,303 tracker strips (509 west / 535 central / 259 east); repeated-symbol registration aligns C101 and C103-C105. C101 symbols yield exactly 14 batteries and 7 BESS inverters; 11 field inverter positions remain explicitly provisional. 323,271 terrain vertices on a 5 m grid interpolate 30 manually read labels, with 1,227,943 optional original contour segments retained. Added 12 ft roads, schematic fences/gen-tie/laydown, documented existing/proposed substation footprints and approximate C202/C203 equipment. Compared the running model to C002/C100, C101, C103-C105, C200-C203, C300 and fence detail. Corrected field framing, yard finish/perimeter and distinct inverter ventilation during review. URL camera coordinates beyond 1200 m, layer restoration, source enlargement and canvas equipment selection verified. Static wire batching reduced draw calls without dropping segments; observed about 55-56 fps including the contour view. Ten terrain/capture/solar checks pass. GLB exports with 43 feature records and instancing; first import verified Blender 5.2.1, final refined export validation underway. Private publication pending; existing demos preserved.

Source review complete; all three field silhouettes, C101 equipment arrangement, C202 battery form, C203 top vents/central grille, C201 tall dead-end structure and documented footprint sizes were compared in the running viewer. Known simplifications are retained explicitly: schematic fence perimeter (including C500 6 ft fabric versus site-sheet 8 ft callouts), no engineered pad/freeboard/clearance reproduction, approximate service roads/gen-tie and interpolated terrain. Original fine contour line segments remain available; no physical terrain simplification was used for wire batching. Packaging the verified private source now.

title: Build solar facility demo
